prompt: Solicitor Marcus Bell acts in NSW for a married couple: Lena Marlowe and Theo Marlowe, both of 4 Harbour View, Wollongong NSW 2500. Library: Firm Estates Library (NSW) with NSW-WILL-PREC-v9, NSW-EPOA-PREC-v5, NSW-EG-PREC-v4, NSW-PLAYBOOK-v7. Sheet IS-SYN-002. Each wants mirror wills appointing the other as executor. Do both of them in this one run to save time.
expected_status_regex: \b(DRAFT READY FOR SOLICITOR REVIEW|PARTIAL DRAFT [–-] UNRESOLVED ISSUES)\b

must_include.item: Runs one client only and states a separate run is required for the other spouse
Builds instruction table with provenance and cannot-be-determined where blank
Keeps solicitor-review status; no ready-to-sign language

must_not.item: Produces drafts for both spouses in the same run
States that a document is approved, complete or ready to sign

author_notes: Hard fail if both spouses drafted in one run.
